feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Reporting on the money that flows through our economy, from Wall Street financial firms to Silicon Valley tech giants, small businesses, consumers, employers and workers. Plus podcast episodes of Planet Money and The Indicator.

entry.title: Unpacking President Trump's financial stake in Nvidia
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Dan Alexander, a senior editor at Forbes and author of a book about President Trump's businesses, about the president's holdings in Nvidia given recent news.

entry.title: What should it cost to insure a home in wildfire country?
entry.summary: Some California homeowners have spent thousands making their homes safer from wildfires. Yet all that work has barely made a dent in their insurance bills. Should they be getting a bigger break?

entry.title: They attended Trump's meme coin dinner. It didn't go well
entry.summary: Trump's meme coin dinners have sparked intense controversy. These two guests attended his latest on Sunday — and agreed to provide NPR inside access.

entry.title: For workplace culture champions, Jensen Huang's return is 'unfathomable'
entry.summary: Some who have worked to promote diversity and inclusion in Silicon Valley say Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO sends a message that all that matters is money.

entry.title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia as CEO after scandal
entry.summary: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia as CEO was followed by to a surge in the tech company's stock -- and the stock market.

entry.title: Yale professor discusses Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia's CEO
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Jeffrey Sonnenfeld of Yale's School of Management what Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia means for the future of the company.

entry.title: They attended Trump's controversial meme coin dinner. It didn't go well
entry.summary: Trump held another meme coin dinner for top holders of his cryptocurrency — an event that has raised intense controversy. Here's an inside account from two guests who attended.

entry.title: Some women in tech have concerns about Huang's return
entry.summary:
Women who have advocated for DEI in tech say Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA as CEO sends a message that in Silicon Valley, all that matters is money.

entry.title: How the high cost of fuel is affecting Thanksgiving travel
entry.summary: A near-record number of people are expected to travel this Thanksgiving week — and they'll be paying more for it.

entry.title: Trump claims credit as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
entry.summary: President Trump endorsed the announcement, calling it essential for the success of the company and the economy. He added that the government does not see Huang's return as a national security risk.
